What we do

Solar panel and roof cleaning is our specialty. We look after the rest of your property too.

Our specialty

Solar panel cleaning

A thorough clean of the glass and a detail of the aluminium frames, using eco-conscious methods that are safe for your panels.

Roof cleaning

Pressure washing and soft washing to lift moss, lichen, mould and grime without damaging your roof.

Gutters and downpipes

Gutters cleared and downpipes flushed, plus bird nest removal and prevention around your solar array.

Property maintenance

Electrical work

A licensed electrician on the team, for repairs, lighting, power points and general electrical jobs.

Lawn and garden care

Mowing, edging and tidy-ups to keep homes and commercial grounds looking cared for.

Handyman jobs

The odd jobs around the property that need doing, handled while we're already on site.
